sentences.text: Across the five tabular benchmarks, Fernwood achieved a higher mean test AUROC (80.6) than Quillgate-GBDT (80.3), but the advantage was not uniform across datasets.

Fernwood outperformed Quillgate-GBDT on Alder-Credit (82.1 vs. 80.4), Birchfield-Churn (87.3 vs. 86.0), and Edgerton-Default (70.2 vs. 67.8), while Quillgate-GBDT was superior on Cobalt-Insure (73.9 vs. 72.1) and Dunmore-Fraud (93.5 vs. 91.1).
Because no statistical tests were reported, the observed differences cannot be characterized as statistically significant.
